_comment: What each Zone IS, never what colour it should be (ADR-0020: design owns treatment, the venue owns relationships). Hand-authored curation lives outside grounding.json so a re-harvest onto the classes schema (#26) cannot drop it (#35, #791). Rockville and DC Universe are the steel coaster quarters; Spassburg is the German village streetscape; Los Festivales the festival midway; Fiesta Bay Boardwalk the lakeside promenade; Texas State Square the civic plaza you enter through.
